events.title: Debut of "Doctor Who" British TV Series
events.description: The first episode of the British science-fiction television series "Doctor Who" aired on November 23, 1963, marking the beginning of the longest-running science fiction show in the world.

deaths.name: Al Raby
deaths.bio: Al Raby was an African American civil rights activist, cochair of the Chicago Freedom Movement in the 1960s.
